title: GO出行总裁中岛：跨境合作拓展，入境游客打车量持续攀升
speaker: Taroishi Nakajima

segments.en: For example, we have partnered with Kakao-T in South Korea
segments.zh: 例如，我们与韩国Kakao T达成了合作

segments.en: When Korean customers travel to Japan they can open the Kakao-T app and use it to call a taxi
segments.zh: 韩国游客到日本旅行时，打开Kakao T应用就能叫到出租车

segments.en: On the back end even though the customer is using the Kakao-T app, the driver's side app is provided by GO
segments.zh: 后台层面，虽然乘客使用的是Kakao T应用，但司机端应用由GO提供

segments.en: By connecting the services through roaming customers are able to use our taxi network
segments.zh: 通过漫游连接服务，乘客就能使用我们的出租车网络

segments.en: We're now working on similar partnerships with companies in China, ASEAN and around the world
segments.zh: 我们正在与中国、东盟及全球各地的企业推进类似合作

segments.en: As a result usage by inbound overseas customers is continuing to increase
segments.zh: 因此，海外入境游客的使用量持续增长

segments.en: And I think we're competing quite effectively in that area
segments.zh: 我认为我们在这方面具备较强的竞争力
